description: This file contains test functions for timeout handling, panic recovery, and connection management in the Kubernetes API server, including tests for HTTP/2 and TLS configurations.

classes.name: recorder
classes.description: A thread-safe counter used in tests to record invocation counts.

classes.name: panicOnNonReuseTransport
classes.description: Custom HTTP transport that panics if a connection is reused unexpectedly, used in HTTP/2 connection tests.

classes.name: baseTimeoutWriter
classes.description: Decorator for http.ResponseWriter used in timeout tests.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Increments the internal count in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the current count in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: RoundTrip
methods.description: Performs an HTTP round trip, delegating to the underlying transport.

methods.name: GotConn
methods.description: Checks if the connection was reused; panics if a non-reused connection is detected.
